message.content: I can't say for certain, and I shouldn't guess beyond the record. What the record actually shows is that two different orderings produced two different selections, even though the candidates and attributes were identical. That is the basis for suspecting the choice depends partly on order, so a third shuffle could well yield a different constrained candidate, or possibly one of the two already seen.
